owners.mentor: Durable relationships, applications, per-player daily counters/break cooldown, mission high-water progress/claim state and graduation exam receipts
owners.playerroot: Canonical I4 player roots rank 315 and academy level/profile reads
owners.playerpresentation: Canonical author display cards for relations and applications
owners.library: Student background-count baseline for the BG missions
owners.i5: All mission/exam grants and overflow mail
owners.content: Versioned mentor catalog and active content revision

invariants: No second durable friend owner; friendship stays SocialRelation and gifts stay SocialGift
Every mutation locks canonical player roots in sorted order first, then the mentor rows; the player root is the concurrency guard
All writes are Serializable; reads are RepeatableRead ReadOnly
Actor liveness/identity is validated before any transaction
Mission progress is high-water and never regresses; hidden rows are never emitted or granted
Business refusals are HTTP 409 with a stock message code; malformed params are 400; unavailable is 503
No invented push routes, grant owners or operator surface

clauses.title: 1856 GET_CLASS_INFO
clauses.rule: Returns base_info (two slot arrays), apply_list and mission_list built from the actor's real relationship, application, counter and mission state.
clauses.refusal: 409 stock code for a business refusal; 400 invalid_mentor_request on extra/wrong params; 503 mentor_unavailable

clauses.title: 1857 APPLY_RELATION
clauses.rule: Target must be a distinct same-server player; the pair is validated (levels, 60/10/90 gates, 3-level gap, slot occupancy, break cooldowns, same-person both roles), the daily per-role counter is checked and incremented, and a pending application with a 48h TTL is written.
clauses.reply: full class info (same shape as C1)
clauses.refusal: 409 with stock codes 34002 (actor break), 34003 (target break), 34008 (daily limit), 34009/34001 (level/gap), 34005 (slot filled), 34010 (pending application), 34015/34016 (slot already held), 34018 (cross-server), 34019 (same person both roles); 400 invalid_mentor_request for malformed params
clauses.idempotency: no semantic receipt; a repeat with an active pending application refuses 34010, an expired/denied one may be replaced
clauses.concurrency: Serializable; player roots locked sorted, then both relationship sets and the application row
clauses.test: TestI9_10FMentorLifeCycleThroughDispatcher (apply + apply_list); TestI9_10FMentorDailyApplicationLimit (3 then 34008); GAP: dispatcher proof for 34001/34005/34009/34015/34016/34018/34019

clauses.title: 1858 GET_CLASS_FINDING_LIST
clauses.rule: Scans at most 100 same-server candidates from the actor id (wrapping once from the server band start), optionally filters by exact name or numeric player id, drops ineligible/cooldown/slot-held candidates, sorts by recent activity, shuffles the most recent 40 deterministically from the operation UUID and returns at most 20 cards with is_send_apply.
clauses.refusal: 400 invalid_mentor_request for bad relation_type/filter type; 503 unavailable
clauses.idempotency: pure read; shuffle is response composition, not durable state
clauses.test: TestI9_10FMentorLifeCycleThroughDispatcher (1858 finds the level-60 teacher with is_send_apply false); GAP: filter_str name/id search is untested

clauses.title: 1859 ACCEPT_TEACH_APPLY
clauses.rule: Requires a pending, unexpired application from the target; revalidates pair eligibility and slot emptiness; ensures a friendship, inserts the relationship pinned to the active content revision, marks the application accepted, advances the mentor's student-level missions and the student's join-class mission, and returns class info.
clauses.reply: full class info (same shape as C1)
clauses.idempotency: no semantic receipt; a second accept refuses 34010 because the application is no longer PENDING
clauses.concurrency: Serializable; player roots sorted, both states, application row, both relationship sets

clauses.title: 1860 DENY_TEACH_APPLY
clauses.rule: Either denies one pending application from a named player or denies all pending applications to the actor; missing rows are skipped in deny-all mode and refused 34010 for a single target.
clauses.refusal: 409 34010 when the named application is missing/not pending; 400 when both or neither of from_player_id/is_deny_all is supplied
clauses.idempotency: no receipt; a second single deny refuses 34010, deny-all is a no-op on an empty list
clauses.concurrency: Serializable; player roots sorted, application rows

clauses.title: 1861 TERMINATE_RELATION
clauses.rule: The actor's own slot (1 mentor / 2 student) identifies the relation; the relation must be at least the minimum age, then it is ended, the raiser receives the 24h break cooldown, and the other side is not punished.
clauses.reply: full class info (same structure as C1) with the slot cleared
clauses.idempotency: no receipt; a repeat after the relation ended refuses 34010
clauses.concurrency: Serializable; roots sorted, then relation rows; only the raiser's state is written
clauses.test: TestI9_10FMentorLifeCycleThroughDispatcher (34012 then terminate after 25h, then 34002 on re-apply)

clauses.title: 1862 GET_CLASS_MISSION_AWARD
clauses.rule: Requires a visible mission, not already awarded, and completion (high-water, join-class relation, own level or exam receipt); grants the mission gift, records the award atomically, and for the graduation mission (100025) samples the student facts, advances the mentor graduated high-water and ends the relation.
clauses.refusal: 409 34010 for unknown/hidden mission, 33002 for an already awarded mission, 1 for incomplete, 34004 for graduation without a mentor relation; 400 malformed
clauses.idempotency: no semantic receipt; a second claim refuses 33002 (tested)
clauses.concurrency: Serializable; roots sorted; graduation also locks the mentor's relation and mission rows
clauses.test: TestI9_10FMentorGraduationExamAndClaim (claim, relation ended, mentor 100001 progress, 33002 replay)

clauses.title: 1863 STUDENT_OVER_FIGHT_RESULT
clauses.rule: The client fights locally and reports is_win; only is_win=1 is accepted. The student must have a mentor relation and be at least the mission level (90). The exam items are granted, a receipt bound to the relation is inserted and the graduation-test mission is completed; a replay refuses 30005 (errorIdFightExist).
clauses.reply: {items:[{item_id:int,item_num:int}]} per the client; GAP: backend emits {items:[{item:int,num:int}]} via i5.StockMID369Rewards at award.go:290 and internal/application/i5/service.go:1743-1756
clauses.idempotency: terminal receipt keyed by student+mission; replay refuses 30005
clauses.concurrency: Serializable; player root and exam receipt row
clauses.test: TestI9_10FMentorGraduationExamAndClaim (1863 grants 3 items, replay 30005); GAP: reply wire shape mismatch with BattleCreate.lua:3866-3875

clauses.title: Level gates and the 3-level gap
clauses.rule: Mentor level >= 60; student level > 10 and < 90; mentor-student level difference >= 3. The gap is the versioned reconstruction policy I9_MENTOR_LEVEL_GAP_AT_LEAST_V1 because the client has no comparator; a missing policy fails closed.
clauses.client: app/windows/TeacherWindow.lua:163-169 (mentor branch), applied through the stock TEACHER_RULE text; data/tables/misc.lua teacher level and student limit
clauses.refusal: 409 34001 when the student is at/over the limit, 34009 for a level/gap failure
clauses.concurrency: levels are read under the transaction

clauses.title: Daily limit, request TTL and cooldowns
clauses.rule: At most 3 applications per role per UTC day (find-a-mentor and find-a-student counted separately); a pending request expires after 48h; a raiser cannot start a new relation for 24h after breaking; a relation cannot be terminated before it is 24h old.
clauses.client: app/windows/TeacherWindow.lua:163-169 and rule text; client sends no timezone or reset time
clauses.idempotency: counters are stored in the state row with a per-day key
clauses.concurrency: state rows are locked under the root

clauses.title: Mission high-water and graduation
clauses.rule: Mentor missions are high-water across all students (graduated count, highest student level, BG count, bond) and survive the student leaving or graduating; each mission is claimable once. The graduation mission is 100025; claiming it ends the relation and does not punish the graduate.
clauses.idempotency: completion timestamps and awarded_at make a claim once-only
clauses.test: TestI9_10FMentorGraduationExamAndClaim (mentor 100001 progress after graduation); internal/domain/mentor/mission_test.go TestResolveMissionsHighWaterAndHiddenRows

clauses.title: Friendship and daily bond
clauses.rule: Accepting a relation adds the pair as friends through SocialRelation; the gift path raises the pair bond by 100 at most once per UTC day up to the 3000 cap, and the mentor's bond mission high-water advances.
clauses.client: app/windows/TeacherWindow.lua:732-739 (accept reply used to add the friend row)
clauses.reply: class info after accept; bond projected in base_info.intimacies/daily_intimacy_add
clauses.idempotency: AddIntimacyTx updates only when the day key differs and the cap allows
clauses.concurrency: caller already fenced both player roots; only the relation row is locked

clauses.title: Login-embedded 1856 projection
clauses.rule: The login snapshot carries the same class record under key 1856, built by the same read path with caller-supplied time; it owns no gameplay authority and performs no write.

clauses.title: Idempotency
clauses.rule: Mentor has no semantic receipt family. Duplicate safety is state-based: claim/exam have terminal rows and refuse repeats (33002/30005); accept/deny/terminate refuse after the state changes (34010); apply replaces an expired/denied application and refuses an active pending one (34010).
clauses.idempotency: GAP: exact replay of apply/accept/deny/terminate is not receipt-backed and is not proven
clauses.concurrency: state rows and terminal receipts guard duplicates

clauses.title: Reply and refusal transport
clauses.rule: Success is HTTP 200 source-shaped; a business refusal is HTTP 409 with the best stock error_code; malformed params are 400 invalid_mentor_request; unavailable is 503 mentor_unavailable.
clauses.client: app/common/network/Backend handling: any 200 is OK and callbacks index nested fields; BattleCreate treats 30005 as errorIdFightExist

clauses.title: Lock order and concurrency
clauses.rule: Mutations lock canonical player roots sorted ascending, then mentor state/application/relationship/mission rows; overlapping pairs therefore serialize on the shared player root, and stale row versions abort.

clauses.title: Function-50 qualification
clauses.rule: The domain requires a qualified function-50 gate fact; the application path currently passes GateOpen=true for both sides, so the gate is only enforced indirectly by the academy-level checks and the separate function-opening system.
clauses.test: TestI9_10FFunction50Kind8Gate (i5 opening only); GAP: Mentor does not verify function 50

clauses.title: D476 operator tunables
clauses.rule: D476 does not apply to Mentor: no store, overlay or operator endpoint is delivered in this leaf; the source rules are read-only catalog values.
